A custom data_as_elements list names the elements to convert

```swift title="Swift"
import HtmlToMarkdown

let _options = try HtmlToMarkdown.conversionOptionsFromJson("{\"data_as_elements\":[\"section\"]}")
let result = try HtmlToMarkdown.convert(html: "<div><section data-as=\"p\">First</section><section data-as=\"p\">Second</section></div>", options: _options)
debugPrint(result.content as Any)
```
